Rhea (Marketing): Quick final for 'Launch Metrics Lab' tomorrow 10am PT. Need owners: reg confirmation copy, calendar ICS, zoom recording + transcript settings, clip handoff timing, HubSpot tag mapping. Keep replies short.

Owen (Events): I'll take greenroom and local OBS backup. Cloud recording ON. Will join 30m early for audio check.

Laila (Ops): zoom-bot: confirm cloud record webhook + s3 path, and whether to enable slide-change markers.

zoom-bot: Meeting link https://zoom.us/j/555555555. Cloud recording enabled, auto-transcript enabled. Webhook target /hooks/zoom/launchlab-upload. S3: s3://redwood-marketing/launch-lab/2026-10-05/. markers_enabled=true.

Marco (Content): I'll do highlight edit + 2 social cuts (60s, 30s). Need master MP4 + SRT + markers.csv. SLA: highlights within 36h, full SRT within 72h. Filename pattern: 20261005-launch-metrics_master.mp4

Jules (Growth): HubSpot fields: tag=launch-metrics-2026, attended boolean, source=webinar. If company_domain matches our trial list set is_trial=true and notify AE. Flow: attended -> immediate replay + survey; no-show -> 3-email replay drip.

Rhea (Marketing): Draft confirmation: "You're registered! Add to calendar  [link]. Join: <zoom link>. We'll email replay, slides, and clips within 48 hours. Optional: submit 1 prep question." I'll upload ICS and template to /assets/email-templates/.

Laila (Ops): Webhook payload will include s3_mp4, s3_srt, markers_csv_url, replay_url_ttl_days=14, company_domain, is_trial, editor_priority flag. Will attach markers.csv for editors to pick timestamps.

Marco (Content): Request editor_priority=high for launch clip. Also please include a short clips_note URL if marketing needs specific timestamps.

Jules (Growth): Gate full master download on survey_completed=true. Keep 60s preview clips public. Add property survey_completed to HubSpot.

Rhea (Marketing): Owners recap: Owen=greenroom/local backup, Laila=upload+webhook, Marco=edits+clips, Jules=HubSpot mapping+drips, Rhea=copy+templates. Any last blockers? :thumbsup:

Owen (Events): All good. See you in greenroom. :raised_hands:
